steps.en: Install the workspace on the box already running hermes-agent
steps.zh: 在已跑着 hermes-agent 的机器上装 workspace

steps.en: Point it at the gateway and the dashboard your agent already serves
steps.zh: 把它指向 agent 已经在服务的 gateway 和 dashboard

steps.en: Probes those endpoints and lights up only the panes your agent actually exposes
steps.zh: 探测这些端点，只点亮 agent 真的暴露的面板

steps.en: Open it in a browser or install the PWA on your phone
steps.zh: 用浏览器打开，或在手机上装成 PWA

steps.en: Renders the agent's own state: sessions, memory, skills, jobs, MCP, and a live PTY
steps.zh: 渲染 agent 自己的状态：会话、记忆、技能、任务、MCP、实时终端

steps.en: In Swarm mode, dispatches work to tmux workers by role and tracks it on a kanban board
steps.zh: Swarm 模式下按角色把活派给 tmux worker，用看板跟踪

value.en: Your agent's own state becomes a phone-reachable console — no ssh, no fork of the agent
value.zh: agent 自己的状态变成手机可达的控制台——不用 ssh，也不用 fork agent

sources: README 'Already running hermes-agent? Attach the workspace to it' (pnpm install; echo 'HERMES_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8642' >> .env; echo 'HERMES_DASHBOARD_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9119' >> .env; pnpm dev -> http://localhost:3000)
README 'Requirements' (API_SERVER_ENABLED=true so the gateway serves core APIs on :8642; `hermes dashboard` on :9119 provides config, sessions, skills and jobs APIs for zero-fork installs)

README v2 zero-fork note (Chat, sessions, memory, skills, jobs, MCP, terminal, dashboard, Agent View and Operations in vanilla parity; Conductor falls back to Workspace-native Swarm dispatch when the dashboard endpoint is absent)
README 'Swarm Mode' and docs/swarm/ (persistent tmux workers, role-based dispatch, kanban task board)
README remote-access section (HERMES_PASSWORD is required off-loopback; Tailscale addresses for HERMES_API_URL / HERMES_DASHBOARD_URL)
